metadata.title: User Guide: How to Login
metadata.description: Complete guide for users to access the IoT Monitoring System platform
metadata.author: IoT Support Team

sections.title: Access the Login Page
sections.content:
Step 1: Navigate to Login Page

Open your web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge) and enter the IoT Monitoring System URL:

URL: Your administrator will provide the specific URL
Example: https://iot.yourcompany.com

The login page will display automatically. If you're already logged in, you'll be redirected to the dashboard.

sections.title: Enter Your Credentials
sections.content:
Step 2: Input Login Information

On the login page, you'll see two input fields:

  1. Email/Username: Enter the email address or username provided by your administrator
  2. Password: Enter your password (case-sensitive)
Important Tips:
  • Make sure Caps Lock is OFF
  • Check your keyboard language settings
  • Passwords are case-sensitive

sections.title: Login Options
sections.content:
Step 3: Configure Login Settings

Before clicking the Login button, you may see additional options:

Remember Me Checkbox

Check this box if you want the system to remember your login for 30 days on this device.

Security Warning:
Only use 'Remember Me' on your personal device. Never use it on public or shared computers.

sections.title: Complete Login
sections.content:
Step 4: Submit and Access Dashboard

Click the button.

Successful Login

If your credentials are correct, you'll be redirected to your dashboard automatically within 2-3 seconds.

Failed Login

If you see an error message:

  • 'Invalid credentials' - Check your email/username and password
  • 'Account locked' - Contact your administrator (too many failed attempts)
  • 'Account disabled' - Contact your administrator

sections.title: Forgot Password
sections.content:
Step 5: Reset Password (If Needed)

If you forgot your password:

  1. Click the 'Forgot Password?' link below the login form
  2. Enter your registered email address
  3. Click 'Send Reset Link'
  4. Check your email inbox (and spam folder)
  5. Click the reset link in the email
  6. Enter your new password twice
  7. Click 'Reset Password'
Reset links expire after 24 hours. If expired, request a new one.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
sections.content:
Common Login Issues

ProblemSolution
Can't access login pageCheck internet connection, verify URL is correct, clear browser cache
Forgot email/usernameContact your administrator or check your welcome email
Password not workingVerify Caps Lock is off, check keyboard language, use 'Forgot Password'
Page keeps loadingRefresh the page (F5), try different browser, check firewall settings
